_about: The variables atlas-api does NOT read, described for the settings catalogue (backend/settings_catalog.py, TASK-1433): atlas-mcp's own (mcp/app/*.py) and the ones only docker compose reads (a ${...} in deploy/oss/*.yml, and COMPOSE_*). They are kept here, as data, so the scans that find what the code reads (tools/ci/check_env_example.py, settings_catalog.names_in_api) do not mistake a description for a read. backend/verify_config_catalogue.py fails when mcp/app or deploy/oss names a variable missing here, or this names one they do not.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_BASE_URL
atlas-mcp.summary: The API's URL as atlas-mcp reaches it; https is required. Required to start.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_CA_BUNDLE
atlas-mcp.summary: The PEM CA bundle atlas-mcp checks the API's certificate against.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_TOKEN
atlas-mcp.summary: The shared fallback token for callers that send none; used only with ATLAS_MCP_ALLOW_SHARED_TOKEN on.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_ALLOW_SHARED_TOKEN
atlas-mcp.summary: Let a caller with no token of its own act with ATLAS_TOKEN (a migration fallback; off by default).

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
atlas-mcp.summary: The Host headers atlas-mcp answers; any other Host is a 421.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
atlas-mcp.summary: The Origin headers atlas-mcp accepts when a request carries one.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_AUTH_CACHE_S
atlas-mcp.summary: Seconds atlas-mcp remembers that the API accepted a caller's token.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_CLIENT_CERT_FILE
atlas-mcp.summary: The client certificate atlas-mcp presents to the API's TLS front (the optional mTLS leg).

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_CLIENT_KEY_FILE
atlas-mcp.summary: The private key of that client certificate.

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_ENABLE_DELETE
atlas-mcp.summary: Register the delete tools (off by default).

atlas-mcp.name: ATLAS_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES
atlas-mcp.summary: The scopes an MCP client is told to ask its identity provider for.

compose.name: ATLAS_PUBLIC_HOST
compose.summary: The host name the install is reached on.
compose.use: atlas-tls's site name (CADDY_PUBLIC_HOST); atlas-api's healthcheck sends it as Host

compose.name: ATLAS_TLS_MODE
compose.summary: Where the TLS front's certificate comes from.

compose.name: ATLAS_TLS_CLIENT_AUTH
compose.summary: Whether the TLS front asks for a client certificate.

compose.name: ATLAS_TLS_BIND
compose.summary: The host address the TLS front publishes on.

compose.name: ATLAS_TLS_PORT
compose.summary: The host port the TLS front publishes on.

compose.name: ATLAS_TLS_CLIENT_CA_FILE
compose.summary: The CA that client certificates are checked against.
compose.use: the client_ca secret mounted into atlas-tls

compose.name: ATLAS_TLS_CF_TOKEN_FILE
compose.summary: The file holding the DNS token for ACME over Cloudflare.
compose.use: the cf_dns_api_token secret mounted into atlas-tls

compose.name: ATLAS_ORIGIN_SUBNET
compose.summary: The subnet of the network between the TLS front and the API.
compose.use: the origin network's subnet, and atlas-api's ATLAS_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS

compose.name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
compose.summary: The optional services to start (the profiles of deploy/oss/docker-compose.yml).

compose.name: COMPOSE_FILE
compose.summary: The compose files docker compose reads, instead of -f options.

compose.name: ATLAS_IMAGE_API
compose.summary: The released atlas-api image (tag@digest) to run instead of building it.
compose.use: release.yml's image for atlas-api, atlas-migrate and atlas-retrieval

compose.name: ATLAS_IMAGE_MCP
compose.summary: The released atlas-mcp image (tag@digest) to run instead of building it.

compose.name: ATLAS_IMAGE_BACKUP
compose.summary: The released backup image (tag@digest) to run instead of building it.

compose.name: ATLAS_IMAGE_POSTGRES
compose.summary: The released Postgres image (tag@digest) to run instead of building it.

compose.name: ATLAS_IMAGE_TLS
compose.summary: The released TLS front image (tag@digest) to run instead of building it.

compose.name: ATLAS_GATEWAY_BIND
compose.summary: The host address the gateway profile's TLS door publishes on.

compose.name: ATLAS_GATEWAY_PORT
compose.summary: The host port the gateway profile's TLS door publishes on.

compose.name: ATLAS_GATEWAY_SESSION_KEY_FILE
compose.summary: The file holding the gateway's MCP session-ID encryption key; unset, session IDs are not encrypted.
compose.use: the key render-gateway.py writes into ./gateway/agentgateway.yaml as config.session.key (that file then 0600)

compose.name: ATLAS_BACKUP_HOST_DIR
compose.summary: Where the backup profile keeps its dumps on the host.

compose.name: ATLAS_DB_CA_SOURCE
compose.summary: The host file holding an external database server's CA certificate.
compose.use: external-db.yml's db_ca secret mounted into atlas-migrate, atlas-api and atlas-backup

compose.name: ATLAS_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_SOURCE
compose.summary: The host file holding the OIDC client secret.

compose.name: ATLAS_OIDC_CLIENT_KEY_SOURCE
compose.summary: The host file holding the private_key_jwt key.

compose.name: ATLAS_OIDC_GROUP_MAP_SOURCE
compose.summary: The host file holding the OIDC group map.

compose.name: ATLAS_EMBED_KEY_SOURCE
compose.summary: The host file holding the embeddings endpoint's key.

compose.name: AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_DIR
compose.summary: The host directory holding the federated token (workload identity).

compose.name: AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_NAME
compose.summary: The federated token's file name in that directory.
